post.summary: Log in from any client surface
post.description: Single login for the admin web, staff app, resident app, and visitor app. The optional `audience` decides which surface the token is valid for and is verified against the caller's profile before a token is issued: `staff` needs an active Membership, `resident` needs a Resident record, `visitor` needs an ExternalPerson record. A platform admin (`accountState.userType = admin`) may sign in on the staff audience without a Membership, so the first superAdmin can bootstrap the first organization. The response `access` block reports `highestRole`, `isPlatformAdmin`, `defaultSurface`, and menu-ready `modules` / `moduleMenu` (grouped permissions per sellable module) so the client can build navigation without parsing flat permission keys.

post.description: Platform operator only. Creates the organization in pendingActivation with no owner membership, and emails the named owner a single-use invitation. The organization stays unusable until that invitation is accepted, which creates the owner membership, sets ownerUserId, and flips the status to active. Until a mail provider is configured the link is written to the server console and returned as ownerInvitation.acceptUrl. Entitlements may be supplied here via moduleAccess, or set later with PUT /module-access.
